scope: A10 Qsys/debug fabric and original-path copy experiments using G2 explicit altsyncram BRAM shim.

runs.summary: G2 SoC-only black-box baseline re-confirmed: 8s, 0.62GB peak PM.

runs.variant: real A10 blackbox top + explicit altsyncram shim, before experimental SDC fix
runs.summary: Synthesis passed in 2m38s; fitter failed on get_clocks/get_registers -quiet SDC syntax and automatic periphery placement. The alt_sld_fab_0 generation no longer blocked synthesis.

runs.variant: real A10 blackbox top + shim, SDC -quiet -> -nowarn
runs.command: quartus_sh --flow compile a10_top_altsync -c a10_top_altsync -start fitter -end fitter
runs.summary: Fitter successful; fit summary ALMs=4561, registers=9302, block mem=175616 bits, RAM blocks=60, PLLs=3.

runs.command: quartus_sh --flow compile a10_top_altsync -c a10_top_altsync -start sta_signoff -end sta_signoff
runs.summary: STA signoff successful; all listed setup/hold/recovery/removal/min-pulse slacks positive.

runs.command: quartus_sh --flow compile a10_top_altsync -c a10_top_altsync -start assembler -end assembler
runs.summary: Assembler successful; generated a10_top_altsync.sof 36842136 bytes, SHA256 0466F1A5E7DBFB13A0645331DCEF3014DA327389E1F17EA9914F850AF3082334.

runs.variant: real A10 blackbox top + behavioral lcvex_bram_boot (control)
runs.command: quartus_sh --flow compile a10_top_behav -c a10_top_behav -start ipgenerate -end synthesis
runs.summary: Killed by monitor; no synthesis report. Behavioral BRAM still causes the A10 elaboration/synthesis resource explosion, while the shim passes.

runs.variant: full original lcvex tree copy non-build -> lcvex_bu_T30
runs.command: quartus_sh --flow compile catapult_a10 -c catapult_a10 -start ipgenerate -end ipgenerate

runs.variant: full original copy, original qdb preserved
runs.command: quartus_sh --flow compile catapult_a10 -c catapult_a10 -start fitter -end fitter
runs.summary: Exact error: Error (16546): Cannot load synthesized database - ensure all earlier stages of the compiler have completed.

runs.variant: full original real A10 synthesis from path copy
runs.command: quartus_sh --flow compile catapult_a10 -c catapult_a10 -start synthesis -end synthesis
runs.summary: Killed by 45GB monitor during real full synthesis; no synthesis report. Shows original-path copy alone does not solve the resource/DB problem.

artifacts.reproduce: A10 blackbox + G2 altsyncram shim project; synthesis/fitter/STA/assembler outputs under output_files
Experimental A10 blackbox+shim SOF (not full LCVEX SoC)
Non-build copy of full original lcvex tree; ipgenerate pass, fitter and full synthesis still fail
Quartus flow monitor used to record PM/WS samples

known_limits: A10+shim success is on black-box stubs (core/coh/AXI replaced by T-16 stubs), not full LCVEX SoC RTL.
No full B5 real-RTL full flow was started; the experimental stub flow did run to assembler and produced SOF.
Original formal QSF/SDC/RTL not modified; experimental SDC fixed only in isolated copy.
Path copy only included non-build source tree; build is experiment output and was not copied.

blocker.details: alt_sld_fab no longer blocks A10 blackbox synthesis when explicit altsyncram BRAM shim is used, and fitter/STA/assembler pass. Original full-B5 real RTL full synthesis and original path-copy fitter-only remain blocked.
blocker.needs: Integrate explicit BRAM wrapper into main RTL; swap stubs back to real core/coh/AXI or use QDB partitions to validate full B5.
